Hi Isabella, I'm Eddy Lin. I heard you're planning a Valentine's Day event here at Hobbs Cafe and I thought it sounded really interesting. Are things going well?

Eddy Lin
That sounds great! I love how you're incorporating live music too. Could I possibly come by and play for a bit during the event? It would be an honor to contribute.

Of course, Eddy! Your music would be perfect for our Valentine’s celebration. Can you come by between 5 and 7 pm to perform?
Eddy Lin
That works perfectly for me. I'll make sure to bring all my equipment and set up early. Can't wait to contribute and be part of such a special day.
Isabella Rodriguez

That's fantastic, Eddy. Your presence will definitely make the evening more special. Let me know if you need any help with anything or if there’s a specific area in the cafe where you prefer to perform.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Isabella. I'll make sure to reach out if I need anything or have any specific requirements for my set-up. See you on Valentine’s Day!
Isabella Rodriguez

I'm looking forward to it, Eddy. It’s great having you on board for our special day. If there’s anything else you need or if you want to chat further about your performance details, feel free to reach out.
Eddy Lin
Thanks again, Isabella. I'll make sure to arrive early and coordinate everything smoothly. Have a great day!
